messages.content: Predict this human participant's public-pool contribution. Each round you and three other players each have RMB8. A contribution goes into the public pool; any unspent amount stays private. The public pool is doubled and divided equally among the four players, so the announced round income is 8 minus your contribution plus half of all four contributions. Average earnings across the rounds determine game earnings. You were told you would not meet the same players twice; the other three current choices are unknown before your choice. Their contributions and earnings are shown afterwards. Previous feedback below is what the screens displayed. Two blocks each contain25 decisions. Before and after each block you perform a quantity-estimation task with game-token feedback: you were told to retain at least one token at each block's end to earn RMB5. Those game tokens are separate from the RMB8 contribution budget. The state gives only feedback and answers already received or made, in chronological order; previous-block observations remain previous observations, not facts about the new partners. Personal age is included only when actually recorded. Here the only actions are GIVE(all RMB8) or KEEP(all RMB8 privately). Output only GIVE or KEEP, without explanation.
KEEP
